summaries.Romania: Serbia's student-led opposition swept elections, ousting Vučić after 12 years of rule in a historic democratic shift. Domestically, Romania faces fiscal pressures with Finance Minister Nazare signaling possible new taxes in 2027 while defending the government's deficit management.
summaries.Healthcare: Cancer vaccines are entering mainstream oncology after a century of research, while healthcare systems grapple with staffing shortages and rising costs amid policy uncertainty. Public confidence in health agencies hit record lows as uninsured rates climb and healthcare affordability remains critical.
summaries.Tech: Apple launches foldable iPhone Duo with OLED touchscreen MacBooks this week amid supply constraints and early display failure reports, while AI models see dramatic price cuts suggesting market maturation beyond hype. Open-source communities debate AI's role as the technology delivers disappointing financial returns to most companies.

items.title: Uninsured rate climbs to 11.2% in 2026: Commonwealth Fund

items.title: Few Americans say CDC, FDA are doing a good job: survey
items.snippet: Public confidence in the CDC and FDA has fallen to record lows, with just 26% and 25% of Americans, respectively, rating the agencies’ performance as excellent or good in a Gallup poll.
items.line: Public trust in CDC and FDA plummets to record lows (26% and 25% approval), signaling deep erosion of health agency credibility amid political polarization.
